decisions.reason: As a visibly maintained 2023 launch with its own pages, an agency-focused compliance tool fits the firm's announced expansion of platform and compliance capabilities, so management would continue it rather than abandon invested effort.

Because the web hosting management platform was featured on the home page in both 2023 and 2024 and sits at the core of the firm's agency-focused platform strategy, management would be strongly inclined to persist with it.

A configurable managed hosting plan is very close to the core hosting business and remained on its own page through 2024, so sunk technical and commercial investment plus strategic fit make continuation the likely choice.

Although newer and less prominently presented, extended PHP security support directly reinforces the firm's promise of secure expert-managed hosting, and in 2025 management can readily treat any weak uptake as a temporary early-stage issue.
